info.title: OpenBKN Log Query API
info.description: Machine contract implemented in OpenBKN 0.1.3 for unified log lists, details, sampled facets, source health, and read-only policies. Log export, high-risk governance writes, per-record quarantine access, and compliance_grade are not yet part of this contract.

x-openbkn-authorization-model.managed_knowledge_network_scope_source: BKN Safe GET /api/safe/v1/me/knowledge-network-grants (current-subject direct instance grants only)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches only safe_summary and registered low-sensitivity fields.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page number. The server uses a controlled cursor to keep each page's query range stable.

200.description: Complete or partial success. partial=true when some sources fail.
Details filtered by category, scope, and field permissions.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Like the log list, searches only safe_summary and registered low-sensitivity fields.

200.description: Computes sampled facets for at most 200 records on the current page using the same filters and authorization projection as the log list. sampled_records reports the actual sample size; partial=true means the result must not be interpreted as a full distribution.
Returns only sources visible to the current subject.
Returns the authorized projection of ordinary-log and audit policies.

TimeFrom.name: time_from
TimeFrom.description: Inclusive boundary. Ordinary searches default to the last 24 hours; correlation drill-downs with a Conversation, Interaction, Operation, Request, Trace, or Span identifier default to the last seven days.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque signed cursor bound to filters, effective_subject_id, access_scope_fingerprint, query_watermark, visible sources, and each source keyset. access_scope_fingerprint is normalized from the account, current built-in roles, application ownership, and managed knowledge-network scope.

ResourceScope.description: Strict resource scope. Source and field authorization use independent typed scopes.

trust_level.description: This OpenAPI describes only the ordinary authorized query projection; quarantined records have no query endpoint.

attributes.description: Contains only fields registered in the 0.1.3 allowlist. Full content and secrets must use an Artifact or be rejected at the ingestion boundary.

replayed_from_quarantine_id.description: Used when a quarantined fact first enters the ordinary zone through a later governed process. Version 0.1.3 provides no replay write API.

CursorStale.description: The access_scope_fingerprint, visible source set, or query contract changed. Restart from the first page.

NotDisclosed.description: The record does not exist or cannot be disclosed to the current subject. Returns log_not_disclosed in both cases to prevent enumeration.

PermissionDenied.description: The subject may know that the resource exists but lacks explicit operation permission.

AuthenticationRequired.description: Authentication is missing or invalid; code=authentication_required.

AccessDenied.description: The authenticated subject lacks baseline read permission for the requested category; code=observability_access_denied.
